_description: Anti-circularity retrieval-quality fixture for the 262-skill qwen3 corpus (T11). Headline queries (transcript/disjoint) are derived from GENUINE developer problem statements typed in the source sessions, NOT from the skills' own use_when or description — that ensures the fixture measures real retrieval discriminability, not self-recall. Lexical queries use terms from skill descriptions. Multiview queries use terms that appear ONLY in tools/artifacts/invariants. Use_when queries are a labeled secondary stratum (lightly reworded use_when). Negatives are adversarial plausible queries that match no corpus skill. Built 2026-06-11.
_authoring_protocol: Queries generated by the real claude CLI (claude-sonnet-4-6 via claude --print --output-format json). Anchors validated against the 262 corpus name set before commit. No fabricated/templated queries. Gold skills drawn from 24 source sessions via session_problems.json + corpus_inventory.json prepared by scripts/extract_t11_session_problems.py.

_strata.transcript: Grounded in a genuine developer problem statement from the source session. Does not reuse skill name tokens.
_strata.disjoint: Intent paraphrase in fresh vocabulary; zero token overlap with skill name/use_when.
_strata.lexical: Uses a distinctive technical term from the skill name/description.
_strata.multiview: Uses a term that appears ONLY in tools/artifacts/invariants (not name/desc/use_when).
_strata.use_when: SECONDARY STRATUM: lightly reworded paraphrase of one use_when condition.
_strata.negative: Adversarial: plausible software-dev query that matches no corpus skill.

_split: tuning/held_out disjoint by anchor skill (~55/45); negatives proportionally split
